author: MiniWarGaming
description:
Dave plays his first Warhammer 40k 11th Edition game with Matthew.  He hasn't really played since 8th Edition. He shares his initial impression of diving headfirst into the modern war game and what it was like to learn the complexity of the rule system. Matthew asks questions to see whether he liked the experience. 

Watch the full battle of Dave's first game of Warhammer 40k in the MWG Vault here: 
https://www.miniwargaming.com/content/dave-learns-warhammer-40k-11th-edition-battle-report
